messages:
alex (People Ops): Quick heads-up — attestation recertification owners, please confirm you own the evidence buckets listed in the spreadsheet by EOD Mon (Apr 10). Link: https://redwood-internal.link/attest-2025
maria (Engineering): I can take infra backups + access control artifacts. Which folder should I upload to? :thinking_face:
jordan (Security): Use the secure bucket: s3://redwood-compliance/attest-2025/controls/infra
sam (Legal): When you upload, add a short redaction note if there's any PII, and set the filename suffix _REDACTED if needed. Date format: YYYY-MM-DD
alex (People Ops): thanks @maria — please update the "owner" and "status" columns in the spreadsheet (link above). If you hit a blocker, ping me or @sam and we'll escalate.
maria (Engineering): Got it. Also confirming I'll attach the retention policy PDF (retention_policy_v3.pdf) and the snapshot commands I used (see snippet below):
```
# snapshot command
sudo aws s3 cp /var/log/security-snapshot.tar s3://redwood-compliance/attest-2025/controls/infra/
```
sam (Legal): FYI, include an index.txt listing files and a brief note on why any artifact is partial. That helps auditors.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: Daily ping to owners at 10:00am until upload complete. Use `/compliance done <thread_ts>` to mark complete. :bell:
alex (People Ops): Plan: Apr 5 checkpoint call for owners (15 min). I'll post calendar invite after you confirm. If you can't make it, add a comment in the sheet with your proxy.
maria (Engineering): Confirmed. I'll upload by Apr 9 and add notes. :white_check_mark:
jordan (Security): Quick ask — retention proof needs a signed JIRA ticket or screenshot from the retention policy page. I'll attach the screenshot.
sam (Legal): Thanks everyone. If you anticipate any legal holds or contract exceptions, say so now so we can schedule review.
alex (People Ops): Perfect. Final note: any evidence stored on personal drives won't be accepted — use the secure bucket or the Evidence Upload form. Ping me if you need access. :pray:
